PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits both parts of Angus's clue ("He was beside a crate. He was in a corner of his area."). So Angus (A) must be at row 7, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: With the rows and columns of Angus crossed out, only one square is left for Daisy that fits her clue ("She was beside a shrub. She was in a corner of her area."). So Daisy (D) must be at row 5, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Look at Edith: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 6, column 5. So nobody else can stand at row 6, column 5, or Edith would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Edith's clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a barrel.") needs the person beside a barrel in Edith's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Edith. All of Barnaby's squares are in column 6, so nobody else can use it. All of Cora's squares are in row 3, so nobody else can use it. Edith's own clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a barrel. She was in the Beach or the Store Room.") rules out more squares. So Edith (E) must be at row 6, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Barnaby that fits his clue ("He was in the sixth column."). So Barnaby (B) must be at row 2, column 6. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Cora is now the only person who can still go in column 2. So Cora (C) must be at row 3, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Look at Floyd: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 1, column 5. So nobody else can stand at row 1, column 5, or Floyd would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: The murderer must be in Vera's area without sharing her row or column; that rules out squares for Vera.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_9_en: Who can be the person beside a barrel in Edith's area? Only Vera, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Edith's clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a barrel."). That rules out Vera's other squares. So Vera (the victim) must be at row 4, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_10_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Floyd that fits his clue ("He was not in the Lamp Room."). So Floyd (F) must be at row 1, column 3. Cross out his row and column. Edith is the only person in the Store Room with Vera, so Edith is the murderer!
